text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san! Thank you for accompanying me today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: No problem at all! I was really looking forward to it too! I love shopping and putting together outfits after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Let's definitely find the perfect one-piece dress for your younger sister!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! A reward for placing in her race! I will surely find something she'll love!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This one! And this! And this one too! It suits my sister, it must suit her without a doubt!! Let us buy all of them!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Stop, stooop! First, could you tell me a bit more about your sister?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: More details, you say! In that case, please take a look at this photograph first!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Look at that, isn't she eye-catchingly adorable!? Outstanding grades and a hard worker! Great at cooking and kind! Loves cute things! She is my pride and joy of a little sister!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: An elementary schooler with a cute vibe... So a girly or feminine taste would fit best.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Since it's a reward, she'd probably be happier with something that isn't too plain. Something with ribbons or decorations—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Then how about this super pink one-piece dress with a massive ribbon right here!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I see! It's a bold color, but if we tie it together with accessories, it could work great. Plus this fabric...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I don't know the exact details, but it feels smooth and seems quite stretchy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Good eye! Ease of movement is important too, so centering around this dress...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: We'll add a white collar. Pair it with a beret for a classical look. How about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! That looks like it will suit my sister wonderfully! As expected of the fashion star, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, the word you're looking for is 'fashionista'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Flight-san! Thanks to you, I was able to purchase the most satisfying gift!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here is some ice cream as a token of my gratitude! Please, enjoy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ...Huh? Bakushin O-chan, where's yours?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well... right at the cash register, I realized my wallet was completely empty! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... The same thing happened the last time we went out together, didn't it. Well then...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Here, Bakushin O-chan. Open wide... ahhhn.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhn!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I ate it without thinking! Even though it was supposed to be a thank-you treat for you, Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's fine. It tastes much better when we share it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it is delicious! In that case, may I have one more bite!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Sure, say ahhhn...
On my way back from running errands. Having bought a bit too much and struggling with heavy bags, a horse girl called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are you alright!? Let me help you carry those!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No need for thanks! As class president, doing this is only natural!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Buying too much by accident—I totally understand how that feels. We're on our way back from shopping too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I only meant to tag along, but I had so much fun that I ended up buying clothes for myself too...
choice_data_list: Sounds like you had a wonderful day off.
Sounds like you had a great day off, huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: As for that... yes. Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My wallet is empty, but my heart is overflowing with fulfillment!
